answers.question: platform 1: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: Correct, and expected: tracks 1–2 (Arlanda Express) are reached at grade from the east end of Centralhallen; the plans show no stairs or lift for them.
answers._source: Jernhusen station plan "Centralhallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only

answers.question: platform 10: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: Not so: track 10 has a lift and an escalator from Övre hallen (west side), as well as the walk from Centralhallen.
answers._source: Jernhusen station plan "Övre hallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only; Jernhusen station plan "Centralhallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only

answers.question: platform 13: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: Not so: tracks 13–14 have a lift from Övre hallen (east side); tracks 11–19 are also reached from Nedre hallen.
answers._source: Jernhusen station plan "Övre hallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only; Jernhusen station plan "Nedre hallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only

answers.question: platform 16: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: Partly: the plan marks the way to tracks 15–16 from Övre hallen (east side) with an arrow only, no stair/escalator/lift symbol; tracks 11–19 are also reached from Nedre hallen.
answers._source: Jernhusen station plan "Övre hallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only; Jernhusen station plan "Nedre hallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only

answers.question: platform 17: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: Not so: tracks 17–19 have a lift and an escalator at the north end of Övre hallen.
answers._source: Jernhusen station plan "Övre hallen" (PDF, January 2026), read 2026-10-30; facts only

answers.question: levels L2/L1/L0/L-1: height not measured
answers.answer: Still open: no open source gives the floor heights. The laser gives roof tops only, and the halls are indoors.

open: Floor heights of Centralhallen, Nedre hallen, Övre hallen and the app's "Mezzanine": no open source measures them.
Whether the app's "Mezzanine" (L1) is a real level: it is not on Jernhusen's plans.
Brandsstore, Shoeroom and Subway are in Cityterminalen (the bus terminal), per Jernhusen's overview plan: they may not belong on the railway station map.
